report.answer: Fixed: in `src/domain/batches.js`, `consumptionOrder` sorted batches newest-received first. It now follows the FEFO rule in docs/DATA.md: the batch that expires first goes first, batches with no expiry go last, and ties go to the one received first, then the lower id. Cooking bechamel now takes milk from HD-1022 before HD-1026. I added two regression tests to `tests/stock.test.js` and a CHANGELOG bullet. `npm test` (18/18) and `npm run lint` both pass.
